title: Digestate nutrient and solids observations following anaerobic digestion of fresh, dried, and ensiled riverbank grass
source_location: Table 2, p. 6; methods pp. 3–4; results pp. 5–6
authors: Alessandro Chiumenti; Andrea Pezzuolo; Davide Boscaro; Francesco da Borso
license: CC BY 4.0, as stated in the article
geography: Adige riverbanks near Boara Pisani, Veneto, Northern Italy
evidence_class: peer-reviewed measured laboratory study; B literature evidence
experimental_context: Early-spring mixed riverbank vegetation, mainly Poaceae with Poa and Festuca prevalence, cut to 40 mm; fresh, two-day air-dried, and ensiled without moisture correction or additives. Batch digestion used digestate inoculum from a mesophilic full-scale dairy-manure digester; reported digestate measurements are therefore not a GreenHub or grass-only system result.
reported_values: Table 2 digestate composition and reported TS/VS/TKN removal values for fresh, dried, and ensiled grass conditions. Values and reported SDs are transcribed without conversion. Empty uncertainty fields mean no uncertainty was printed for that cell; they are not zero.
conversion_and_scaling: No conversion or scaling. Units and bases preserve the table's wet-digestate, percent-of-TS, or reported removal basis.
applicability: Phase 5/7 comparator for grass AD digestate composition and solids/nitrogen removal; cannot provide digestate flow, flow-weighted nutrient loads, nutrient speciation beyond TKN/ammonium, or recovery/separation efficiency.
limitations: Italian spring riverbank grass is not Dutch roadside-grass feedstock.
Batch tests and manure-digester inoculum differ from the GreenHub route and continuous operation.
Concentration changes are not flow-corrected elemental balances; do not use as nitrogen recovery or fertilizer product yield.
No P or K measurements or nutrient recovery step are reported in the transcribed table.
Article text reports a concentration-based removal equation with an apparent sign convention ambiguity; this extract preserves the tabulated removal labels and does not recalculate them.
The article contains differing fresh-grass biogas/methane yield figures between abstract, graph, and conclusion; those disputed gas yield values were deliberately excluded from this dataset.
activation_state: reference_only; not connected to calculation or defaults
